d:
Yessir It's Reze, my favorite Chainsaw man girl! The MTL English translation that comes with purchase will be up shortly, but you'd better believe this is getting a full high quality one by yours truly!

Lime's Note:
"This time I drew Reze from Chainsaw Man. It's been awhile since I last drew a character from the series, since Makima.

I planned this after watching the movie.
I was a little unsure about the costume, but I wanted to give off a slutty vibe, so I chose a sling swimsuit.
I love panties, So I might draw her in her normal costume right away (LOL)

Honestly, it didn't have to be Denji as the guy, but after considering how easy it would be to make the story, I decided on this.
Next time I might draw a mob character."

Please Support the official Release
n: [Artist CG] [PURPLE HAZE (Lime)] The Slut Girl (Chainsaw Man)
